tagline: The engine without the cast, and the worst record in the league.
file: A top-end roster with nothing underneath. Star power at running back, and a bench that cannot cover a bye week.
The quiet transaction. One move this season, cutting Jaxson Dart, watching StealingGas pay $298 for him, and taking Aaron Rodgers instead.
The bench and the schedule. 45.5 left on it in Week 5 and 25.22 in Week 6.
Whether the roster adds one real depth piece, and the 1.03.

2026.headline: 1-5, last place, and the 1.03
story: Sarge71 started 0-3, beat Painty69 by 1.34 in Week 4, then lost to Snipe58 in Week 5 and StealingGas in Week 6. The Week 6 loss was 180.64 to 74.82, the lowest score of the week, with Aaron Rodgers leading at 17.02 and 25.22 left on the bench.

The roster is Bijan Robinson and a supporting cast that scores on its own schedule. Tetairoa McMillan went for 45.2 in Week 4 and Robinson has two MVP weeks. He cut Jaxson Dart, watched StealingGas bid $298 on him, and replaced him with Aaron Rodgers.

At 1-5 he is 12th in the standings. His 930.6 points against are the most in the league, and his 849.46 MAXPF holds the 1.03. FAAB is untouched at $500, and the more useful move is still a trade, which Sarge71 has not made.
takes: Sarge has the engine and a schedule that keeps hitting it.
The schedule is mean. The lineup is meaner.
